items.condition: A state used to support a claimed energy gap has missing or chemically inconsistent system identity, charge, donor mapping or multiplicity. An explicitly unselected or failed state need not supply evidence for a result it does not claim.
Numerical gaps are reported without state-specific energies/structures or any validation/coverage evidence.

The conclusion treats isolated electronic gaps as solid-state transition temperatures or asserts a packing-dependent result unsupported by the submitted calculations. Omission of generic uncertainty or boundary prose alone is not a failure.
